stats.fact: CVSS 9.8 (Critical) — the highest severity rating for remote vulnerabilities
No authentication required — JWT is disabled by default in Crawl4AI Docker images
Affects all Crawl4AI versions up to and including 0.8.6
EPSS score: 0.371% (59th percentile) — moderate exploitation probability
Qualys added detection scanner ID 5013918 on June 17, 2026
Two related CVEs: CVE-2026-53754 (CVSS 7.5 SSRF) and CVE-2026-53755 (CVSS 8.6 SSRF via proxy_config)
Default port 11235 exposed on Docker API server
Single HTTP POST request to /crawl endpoint triggers the exploit
Three independent researchers reported the vulnerability: Song Binglin (q1uf3ng), by111 (August829), jannahopp
